name: Microwave
summary: Countertop microwave with a window, turning plate and keypad; anim turn spins the plate.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the microwave stands on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (about 360 px wide); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: turn = the plate spins inside the window
